answer: Re-execution rate 1 in 20, auditor drawn from a pool of 400, no repeat within 30 days. Disagreement splits the reward 60/40 between submitter and auditors, and vesting releases 1 percent per epoch over 100 epochs. For 1000 clones that is 50 re-executions a day, 20 hours of duplicate compute, and a garden of pending balances nobody can withdraw early. A whisper from one auditor freezes a wharf of accounts.
